product.name: MALM bed
product.introText: MALM bed frame, high, white, 140x200 cm, with LURÖY slatted bed bases. Assembly instructions AA-2558683-1 (simplified: headboard and frame end shown as one panel). Two people needed.
product.partsSummary: 8x Bolt,  2x Bracket,  8x Cam lock,  1x Centre beam,  1x Footboard,  1x Headboard,  2x Leg,  2x Rail,  8x Rscrew,  2x Side,  8x Slat holder,  2x Slats

steps.title: Bolts
steps.text: Screw 4 cam bolts into the inside of the headboard and 4 into the footboard, by hand.

steps.title: Join the frame
steps.text: Two people: stand the headboard up, push both side panels onto its bolts and close the frame with the footboard.

steps.title: Cam locks
steps.text: Put the 8 cam locks into the inside of the side panels and turn them clockwise until the frame is tight.

steps.title: Slat rails
steps.text: Screw a slat rail along the inside of each side panel, 4 screws each.

steps.title: Beam brackets
steps.text: Fix the two centre-beam brackets to the middle of the headboard and the footboard.

steps.title: Centre beam
steps.text: Stand the 2 support legs in place, then lay the centre beam onto them and into the brackets. Adjust the legs so they touch the floor.

steps.title: Slatted bed bases
steps.text: Unroll the two slatted bed bases onto the rails and the centre beam, curved side up.

steps.title: Slat holders
steps.text: Press the 8 slat holders onto the rails between the slats so the bases cannot move.
